geo_decision_corrections.policy: Only unique E-catalogue explicit headline subjects override different description-based selections; all other choices unchanged.
geo_decision_corrections.limitations: Catalogue is incomplete. A subject is not a verified event location. Some explicit mentions may be incidental; inspect correction examples.

geo_confidence_evidence.scope: mapped eligible feed occurrences before deduplication
notes: Evidence classes are descriptive, not calibrated confidence scores.
No catalogue match is not a warning and is never counted as an error.
Geographic subject is not a verified event or incident coordinate.
Source URL, publisher, and feed edition are not accepted as incident-location verification.
geo_confidence_evidence.policy: Diagnostic only. No placements or existing matching decisions changed.
